reviews.name: Cemal Elitas
reviews.text: Bevor Vorurteile,  einfach vorbei kommen
reviews.textTranslated: Before you have any prejudices, just come and visit.

reviews.name: Abdul Almhbani
reviews.text: مصلى تركي في مدينة بوخوم
reviews.textTranslated: Turkish prayer room in the city of Bochum

reviews.name: Joe 9
reviews.text: Mashallah, ich war zum besuch mein Cousin hier , und ich muss ihr macht das einfach toll ❤️
reviews.textTranslated: Mashallah, I was visiting my cousin here, and I have to say you guys are doing a great job ❤️

reviews.name: Mosaab Alali
reviews.text: مشاءالله
reviews.textTranslated: God willing

reviews.name: Abdulhamid Basha - Local Guide
reviews.text: bu mescidi bayağı beğendim. mescide girdiğimde uzak yerden geldiğimi bildiklerinde güler yüzle karşıladılar. mescit imamının sesinide beğendim allah razı olsun. artı, mescidin dekoru türkiyedeki güzel günlerimi hatırlattı. bir kere bile olsa bu camide namaz kılmanızı tavsiye ederim.
reviews.textTranslated: I really liked this mosque. When I entered, they greeted me with smiles knowing I had come from far away. I also liked the imam's voice; may God bless him. Plus, the mosque's decor reminded me of my good times in Türkiye. I recommend you pray in this mosque at least once.

reviews.name: Yakup Güven
reviews.text:
Der Imam und die Gemeinde ist so toll es zieh einen schon hin weil man sich sehr wohlfühlt.
Sowohl die Aktivitäten als auch die predigen sind sehr schön und lehrreich
reviews.textTranslated:
The imam and the community are so wonderful; it draws you in because you feel so comfortable there.

Both the activities and the sermons are very enjoyable and informative.

reviews.name: Safa S.
reviews.text: Es gibt einen Ort für Frauen ... eine wunderschöne Moschee. Sie ist zum Gebet geöffnet. Elhamdulillah 🤲
reviews.textTranslated: There is a place for women... a beautiful mosque. It is open for prayer. Alhamdulillah 🤲

reviews.name: Ebru Kamat
reviews.text: Schöne Moschee. Vor der Moschee kann geparkt werden. Bevor die Frauen in den Moschee Bereich kommen, kann wudu genommen werden. Das Bad war sauber und es waren genug Tücher vorhanden. Danke möge Allah eure Gebete annehmen
reviews.textTranslated: Beautiful mosque. Parking is available in front of the mosque. Women can perform wudu before entering the mosque area. The bathroom was clean and there were plenty of towels. Thank you, and may Allah accept your prayers.

reviews.name: Gabriel Mor
reviews.text: Cok ozel Mandeville havasi var
reviews.textTranslated: It has a very special Mandeville vibe.

reviews.name: Shep 1996
reviews.text: Shum mir 👍🏻

reviews.name: Mehmet Celik
reviews.text: Alles wunderschön Elhamdulillah
reviews.textTranslated: Everything is beautiful, Alhamdulillah.

reviews.name: Ahmet Güney
reviews.text: Alles top zum Freitags gebet gibt es viel Platz und man kann dort am Wochenende fastenbrechen
reviews.textTranslated: Everything is great, there's plenty of space for Friday prayers and you can break your fast there on weekends.

reviews.name: Hans Asante
reviews.text:
Ich habe grade mein Gebet verrichtet und bin einfach nur dankbar, dass der Herr mir erlaubt hat an einem so schönen Ort zu beten.

El hamdullilah
reviews.textTranslated:
I just finished my prayer and I'm simply grateful that the Lord allowed me to pray in such a beautiful place.

Alhamdulillah.

title: BKV Moschee Bochum Stahlhausen 🕌 | Camii | مسجد (VIKZ e.V.)

reviews.name: Tuğba Goecen
reviews.text: Bugün geldim kadın mescidi kapalıydı, çok üzücü. Ama yine de 5 yıldız vereyim mi camiler öne çıksın.
reviews.textTranslated: I came today and the women's prayer room was closed, which is very sad. But should I still give 5 stars so that mosques stand out?

reviews.name: Ek Genc
reviews.text: Hier ist jeder willkommen. Super nette Atmosphäre
reviews.textTranslated: Everyone is welcome here. A really nice atmosphere.

reviews.name: Mustafa Gebes
reviews.text: Huzuru mutluluğu sevgiyi gördüğüm yer
reviews.textTranslated: The place where I saw peace, happiness, and love.

reviews.name: Ibrahim Hourani
reviews.text:
Man muss links neben dem Gebäude in die Sackgasse rein, und dann durch die grüne Zaun-Tür in den Innenhof. Und von dort kommt man in die Masjid.
Eine schöne und saubere (bosnische) Moschee.
reviews.textTranslated:
You have to go into the cul-de-sac to the left of the building, and then through the green gate in the fence into the courtyard. From there you can enter the masjid.

A beautiful and clean (Bosnian) mosque.

reviews.name: Иброхимжон Курбонов
reviews.text: Мечет красивая
reviews.textTranslated: The mosque is beautiful

reviews.name: Waseem Yousaf
reviews.text: Jummah time today: 1300uhr

reviews.name: Gandy Lakota
reviews.text: Schönste Moschee im Bochum. Mann sollte einmal kommen und die Ruhe genießen
reviews.textTranslated: The most beautiful mosque in Bochum. One should come and enjoy the peace and quiet.

title: Sultan Ahmet Moschee Verein für Bochum-Dahlhausen Umgebung e.V.

reviews.name: forthesakeofallahswt
reviews.text: Hier wird Quran und Sunnah vorgelebt. Wirklich schön, was die Leute hier eingerichtet haben.
reviews.textTranslated: Here, the Quran and Sunnah are lived out in practice. It's truly beautiful what the people have created here.

reviews.name: Abduri Abduri
reviews.text: Bester Hoca größter Ehrenmann betes Quranhaus auch kostenlos 👀❤️
reviews.textTranslated: Best Hoca, greatest honorable man, prayers at the Quran House, also free 👀❤️

title: مسجد التوبة Moschee Tauba Bochum Dmkv
